title: Qman DirectPath committed Static admission
description: Closed post-commit result for one Static admission transaction. It identifies the committed live OperationLease capability and its one-to-one admission binding; it is never a pre-commit decision or a substitute for live pre-side-effect revalidation.

digestSet.x-qmanSetRule: The guarded Static admission currently commits exactly one dependency bundle. The set is unique and ordered by CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes.

memberGenerations.x-qmanSetRule: Member IDs are unique and the complete array is ordered by ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [id,generation], matching directpath-operation-envelope.schema.json#/$defs/operationLeaseCapability.

x-qmanHashRule: resultHash is SHA-256 of CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over this complete committed result with resultHash represented as null.
x-qmanCommitRule: The complete object may be emitted only after one repository transaction has durably committed the ACTIVE ASSIGNMENT_PREPARE OperationLease, its UNIQUE one-to-one OperationAdmissionBinding, complete bundle reservation, PREPARING AssignmentRun, completed idempotency record, audit event, outbox event, and all listed resource versions.
x-qmanIdempotencyRule: The committed idempotency row is keyed by [operationId=STATIC_ADMISSION,idempotencyScopeHash,idempotencyKey]. idempotencyScopeHash is SHA-256 over UTF-8 domain separator QMAN-DIRECTPATH/IDEMPOTENCY-SCOPE/V1, one zero byte, and CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over {operationId:'STATIC_ADMISSION',vmId}; the row binds the echoed commandHash as its immutable request hash and stores this exact resultHash as its completed response hash. Exact replay returns byte-identical committed result bytes.
x-qmanReferenceIdempotencyLifecycle: The executable SQLite reference component inserts IN_PROGRESS at resourceVersion=1 and completes it by compare-and-swap to COMPLETED at resourceVersion=2. The schema retains a positive-integer shape so this receipt contract does not pretend to freeze a product repository's version allocator.
x-qmanCrossFieldRules: commandId, vmId, runId, and commandHash equal the same fields of the accepted StaticAdmissionCommand
idempotency.naturalKey.idempotencyScopeHash is derived from top-level vmId by the normative domain-separated projection
commandHash is the immutable request hash stored by the committed idempotency row
x-qmanAuthorityBoundary: This receipt-shaped value is a reference transaction result, not proof of a Qman product repository or a live side-effect authorization. Before the first covered host side effect, the executor must independently re-read the live ACTIVE lease and one-to-one binding, check trusted time and every sealed version, and fsync the Host Action Journal INTENT.
